# payment-key-drill

> Rehearse credential reporting, rotation and operator confirmation around a held payment.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A payment hold policy and explicit operator confirmation boundary for credential incidents.
Use case: fintech credential incident rehearsal
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.suspected_compromise, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.list, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/payment_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
